h4_opening_cross.definition: Official opening cross on the listing venue (statistics stat_type 1: price and matched shares). An order is feasible when it is at least one whole share and at most 5% of the cross. account: 2.5% of a $50,000 account in whole shares at the official open. replay: the account order capped at 0.1% of the prior 20-session split-adjusted venue ADV, the frozen replay's sizing. The closing cross is read the same way for the cover.

h18_passive_offer_under_ssr.definition: Restricted sessions (cached Nasdaq SSR state at the entry open): a short-sale offer of the modeled size rests at the listing-venue best offer of the cached book one second after the scheduled open (thirty seconds when the one-second book is missing), behind that level's displayed size, judged within 15 minutes. Each later one-second bar's volume is spread evenly over its tick prices; the part at or above the offer depletes the queue ahead and then fills the order at the offer price. Unrestricted sessions are run the same way as a comparison only.

h19_participation_cost.definition: Sell by taking a fixed share of every one-second listing-venue bar's volume (the opening cross removed) at the bar's range midpoint, from the cached arrival book after the open for 60 minutes; cover the same way over the last 60 minutes with any residual at the official closing print. Cost = (entry arrival mid - sell VWAP) + (buy VWAP - exit arrival price) + crossing fraction x the cached half-spreads (open books for the entry leg, the close book for the cover), all over the entry arrival mid. capacity: the order is the rate times the window's volume. account_*: a fixed order of 2.5% of the account at the arrival mid; completion within the window is reported.

definitions.short_return_convention: 1 - exit price / entry price; positive means the short gained.
definitions.split: By the entry session date. Train 2018-05-01 to 2022-12-31, validate 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-31, holdout from 2025-01-01 (sealed).
definitions.issuer_interval: 95% percentile interval from 2,000 whole-issuer (CIK) bootstrap draws; events of one issuer move together.
definitions.feasible_share: Share of events whose order is at least one whole share and at most 5% of the matched cross shares.
definitions.fill_rate: Share of simulated orders fully filled within 15 minutes of placement; partial fills are reported separately.
definitions.adverse_selection_5m: Last one-second bar close five minutes after completion minus the fill price, over the arrival midpoint; positive is adverse to the short.
definitions.round_trip_cost: Entry shortfall + exit shortfall + crossing fraction x the cached half-spreads, over the entry arrival midpoint; positive is a cost.
definitions.benchmark_minus_cost: The same events' official open-to-close gross short return minus the round-trip cost; H19's kill branch reads this below zero.
definitions.commission_fraction: Round-trip commission, venue fees and clearing (regulatory pass-through excluded) over the entry notional.

limits: Free data only: one-second listing-venue bars and the opening and closing books cached by the earlier quote study; not consolidated volume or NBBO, and no intraday quotes between those books.

The bar fill model spreads each second's volume evenly over the bar's tick prices and credits no cancellations and no re-pricing; fills counted on bars that traded entirely above the offer may in reality have been re-priced orders, so the fill rate is an upper bound and the fill price a lower bound against the book-level model that was not run.
Hidden and midpoint liquidity ahead of the order is invisible in displayed size, which also pushes the fill rate up.

The participation model follows printed volume with no market impact beyond the spread term; at 5% of volume that is optimistic, and the spread term uses the open and close books rather than the spread at each fill time.

Arrival is the cached book one second after the scheduled open (thirty seconds where that record is missing); the exit arrival is the first bar at or after 15:00, up to five minutes later for names that did not print at 15:00.
Halts inside a window simply contribute no bars; LULD and news halts are not modeled as events.
Commission schedules are declared constants (IBKR fixed and tiered at the lowest tier with representative exchange fees); regulatory pass-through uses today's published rates for every year.
The opening-cross feasibility is a size test at the printed price; it does not establish that an auction order of that size would not have moved the cross price.
No borrow, locate or margin assumption enters any number here; H18's realized return to the close is gross of borrow and commissions.
Holdout results exist only under local/holdout and were not read while writing this document; nothing here was selected on them.
